notes:
Updating actually installs now. Until this version the update downloaded, the app closed, and nothing was installed: the script that does the work waited for every process named Jolnova.exe to disappear, but the app always runs as two such processes, so it waited forever. Worse, it had picked the wrong way to install - it was about to copy the installer over the application itself, which would have left you with a setup wizard instead of Jolnova. That never ran only because the wait never finished. Both are fixed: the script waits for this app's own processes with a time limit, and it decides what it downloaded by looking inside the file rather than at its name, choosing the safe path whenever it cannot tell.

Good clips were being thrown away. When a recording was deleted while a clip from it was still being scored, the clip's audio could not be read, so it scored zero for speech and was rejected as "boring" - indistinguishable in the log from a genuinely dull clip. Recordings a clip is still being cut from are now protected from cleanup, the recording budget is no longer smaller than the recordings themselves can grow, and a clip whose source has gone is skipped and said so plainly instead of being given a made-up score.

Jolnova now tells you about a new version by itself. The update bar at the top checks on startup and every few hours; until now it only ever asked a cached answer that was always "no update", so it never appeared and you had to go to Settings and press Check. The bar also stays one line, whatever the length of the release note.

Updating no longer signs you out. Because the app is closed while the update installs, the saved session had often expired by the time it reopened, and you were dropped at the sign-in screen with a message about your internet connection - even though the session refreshed itself moments later. The session is now refreshed and re-checked before anything is shown, the app waits for its own service to finish starting instead of giving up at once, and if the session becomes valid a moment later the app opens by itself.
